diff --git a/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/MFrontRichardsMechanics.h b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/MFrontRichardsMechanics.h
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..1ea697af56
--- /dev/null
+++ b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/MFrontRichardsMechanics.h
@@ -0,0 +1,228 @@
+/**
+ * \file
+ * \copyright
+ * Copyright (c) 2012-2025, OpenGeoSys Community (http://www.opengeosys.org)
+ *            Distributed under a Modified BSD License.
+ *              See accompanying file LICENSE.txt or
+ *              http://www.opengeosys.org/project/license
+ */
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <algorithm>
+
+#include "MFrontGeneric.h"
+#include "Variable.h"
+
+namespace MaterialLib
+{
+namespace Solids
+{
+namespace MFront
+{
+template <int DisplacementDim>
+class MFrontRichardsMechanics
+    : private MFrontGeneric<DisplacementDim,
+                            boost::mp11::mp_list<Strain, LiquidPressure>,
+                            boost::mp11::mp_list<Stress, Saturation>,
+                            boost::mp11::mp_list<Temperature>>,
+      public MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>
+{
+    using Base = MFrontGeneric<DisplacementDim,
+                               boost::mp11::mp_list<Strain, LiquidPressure>,
+                               boost::mp11::mp_list<Stress, Saturation>,
+                               boost::mp11::mp_list<Temperature>>;
+    using KelvinVector = typename Base::KelvinVector;
+    using KelvinMatrix = typename Base::KelvinMatrix;
+
+public:
+    using PressureCoupledResponse =
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::PressureCoupledResponse;
+
+    using Base::Base;
+
+    std::unique_ptr<
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables>
+    createMaterialStateVariables() const override
+    {
+        return Base::createMaterialStateVariables();
+    }
+
+    void initializeInternalStateVariables(
+        double const t,
+        ParameterLib::SpatialPosition const& x,
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables&
+            material_state_variables) const override
+    {
+        Base::initializeInternalStateVariables(t, x, material_state_variables);
+    }
+
+    std::optional<PressureCoupledResponse> integrateStressPressureCoupled(
+        MaterialPropertyLib::VariableArray const& variable_array_prev,
+        MaterialPropertyLib::VariableArray const& variable_array,
+        double const t,
+        ParameterLib::SpatialPosition const& x,
+        double const dt,
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables const&
+            material_state_variables) const override
+    {
+        auto res = Base::integrateStress(variable_array_prev,
+                                         variable_array,
+                                         t,
+                                         x,
+                                         dt,
+                                         material_state_variables);
+
+        if (!res)
+        {
+            return std::nullopt;
+        }
+
+        auto& [forces_data, state, tangent_operator_data] = *res;
+        auto const view = this->createThermodynamicForcesView();
+        auto const swelling_stress =
+            getInternalVectorByName(*state, "sigma_S");
+        auto const liquid_mass_exchange_source =
+            -getInternalScalarByName(*state, "rho_l_hat");
+
+        PressureCoupledResponse response{
+            view.block(stress, forces_data),
+            view.block(saturation, forces_data),
+            blocks_view_.block(stress, strain, tangent_operator_data),
+            blocks_view_.block(stress, liquid_pressure, tangent_operator_data),
+            blocks_view_.block(saturation, strain, tangent_operator_data),
+            blocks_view_.block(saturation, liquid_pressure,
+                               tangent_operator_data),
+            swelling_stress,
+            liquid_mass_exchange_source,
+            std::move(state)};
+        return response;
+    }
+
+    std::optional<std::tuple<KelvinVector,
+                             std::unique_ptr<typename MechanicsBase<
+                                 DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables>,
+                             KelvinMatrix>>
+    integrateStress(
+        MaterialPropertyLib::VariableArray const& variable_array_prev,
+        MaterialPropertyLib::VariableArray const& variable_array,
+        double const t,
+        ParameterLib::SpatialPosition const& x,
+        double const dt,
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables const&
+            material_state_variables) const override
+    {
+        auto response = integrateStressPressureCoupled(variable_array_prev,
+                                                       variable_array,
+                                                       t,
+                                                       x,
+                                                       dt,
+                                                       material_state_variables);
+
+        if (!response)
+        {
+            return std::nullopt;
+        }
+
+        return std::optional<
+            std::tuple<KelvinVector,
+                       std::unique_ptr<typename MechanicsBase<
+                           DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables>,
+                       KelvinMatrix>>{std::in_place,
+                                      response->stress,
+                                      std::move(response->state),
+                                      response->dStress_dStrain};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::InternalVariable>
+    getInternalVariables() const override
+    {
+        return Base::getInternalVariables();
+    }
+
+    double getBulkModulus(double const t,
+                          ParameterLib::SpatialPosition const& x,
+                          KelvinMatrix const* const C) const override
+    {
+        return Base::getBulkModulus(t, x, C);
+    }
+
+    double computeFreeEnergyDensity(
+        double const t,
+        ParameterLib::SpatialPosition const& x,
+        double const dt,
+        KelvinVector const& eps,
+        KelvinVector const& sigma,
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables const&
+            material_state_variables) const override
+    {
+        return Base::computeFreeEnergyDensity(
+            t, x, dt, eps, sigma, material_state_variables);
+    }
+
+private:
+    KelvinVector getInternalVectorByName(
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables const&
+            material_state_variables,
+        std::string const& name) const
+    {
+        auto const internal_variables = Base::getInternalVariables();
+        auto const it =
+            std::find_if(internal_variables.begin(), internal_variables.end(),
+                         [&name](auto const& internal_variable)
+                         { return internal_variable.name == name; });
+
+        KelvinVector values = KelvinVector::Zero();
+        if (it == internal_variables.end() ||
+            it->num_components != values.rows())
+        {
+            return values;
+        }
+
+        std::vector<double> cache;
+        auto const& raw_values = it->getter(material_state_variables, cache);
+        for (Eigen::Index i = 0;
+             i < values.rows() &&
+             i < static_cast<Eigen::Index>(raw_values.size());
+             ++i)
+        {
+            values[i] = raw_values[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
+        }
+        return values;
+    }
+
+    double getInternalScalarByName(
+        typename MechanicsBase<DisplacementDim>::MaterialStateVariables const&
+            material_state_variables,
+        std::string const& name) const
+    {
+        auto const internal_variables = Base::getInternalVariables();
+        auto const it =
+            std::find_if(internal_variables.begin(), internal_variables.end(),
+                         [&name](auto const& internal_variable)
+                         { return internal_variable.name == name; });
+
+        if (it == internal_variables.end() || it->num_components != 1)
+        {
+            return 0.0;
+        }
+
+        std::vector<double> cache;
+        auto const& values = it->getter(material_state_variables, cache);
+        return values.empty() ? 0.0 : values[0];
+    }
+
+    OGSMFrontTangentOperatorBlocksView<
+        DisplacementDim,
+        ForcesGradsCombinations<boost::mp11::mp_list<Strain, LiquidPressure>,
+                                boost::mp11::mp_list<Stress, Saturation>,
+                                boost::mp11::mp_list<Temperature>>::type>
+        blocks_view_ = this->createTangentOperatorBlocksView();
+};
+
+extern template class MFrontRichardsMechanics<2>;
+extern template class MFrontRichardsMechanics<3>;
+
+}  // namespace MFront
+}  // namespace Solids
+}  // namespace MaterialLib
diff --git a/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/ModCamClay_semiExpl_constE_pressureCoupled.mfront b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/ModCamClay_semiExpl_constE_pressureCoupled.mfront
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..e877bbcd6b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/ModCamClay_semiExpl_constE_pressureCoupled.mfront
@@ -0,0 +1,255 @@
+@DSL ImplicitGenericBehaviour;
+@Behaviour ModCamClay_semiExpl_constE_pressureCoupled;
+@Author OpenGeoSys Community;
+@Date 26 / 03 / 2026;
+@Description{
+    Pressure-coupled RichardsMechanics bridge variant of
+    ModCamClay_semiExpl_constE. The mechanical return mapping stays on the
+    native effective-stress modified Cam-Clay path with constant elastic
+    parameters. Liquid pressure only enters through the returned van
+    Genuchten saturation and its tangent, so RichardsMechanics can assemble
+    the pore-pressure coupling outside the solid law exactly as on the native
+    path.
+}
+
+@Theta 1.0;
+@Epsilon 1e-14;
+@MaximumNumberOfIterations 200;
+@ModellingHypotheses{".+"};
+@Algorithm NewtonRaphson;
+
+@Gradient StrainStensor εᵗᵒ;
+εᵗᵒ.setGlossaryName("Strain");
+
+@ThermodynamicForce StressStensor σ;
+σ.setGlossaryName("Stress");
+
+@Gradient real pᴸᴿ;
+pᴸᴿ.setEntryName("LiquidPressure");
+
+@ThermodynamicForce real Sᴸ;
+Sᴸ.setEntryName("Saturation");
+
+@StateVariable StrainStensor εᵉˡ;
+εᵉˡ.setGlossaryName("ElasticStrain");
+
+@StateVariable real Λₚ;
+Λₚ.setGlossaryName("EquivalentPlasticStrain");
+
+@IntegrationVariable strain rpc;
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable stress pc;
+pc.setEntryName("PreConsolidationPressure");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real εᵛₚₗ;
+εᵛₚₗ.setEntryName("PlasticVolumetricStrain");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real vʳ;
+vʳ.setEntryName("VolumeRatio");
+
+@Parameter stress pamb = 1e+3;
+@PhysicalBounds pamb in [0:*[;
+pamb.setEntryName("AmbientPressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty stress young;
+@PhysicalBounds young in [0:*[;
+young.setGlossaryName("YoungModulus");
+
+@MaterialProperty real ν;
+@PhysicalBounds ν in [-1:0.5];
+ν.setGlossaryName("PoissonRatio");
+
+@MaterialProperty real M;
+@PhysicalBounds M in [0:*[;
+M.setEntryName("CriticalStateLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real ka;
+@PhysicalBounds ka in [0:*[;
+ka.setEntryName("SwellingLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real la;
+@PhysicalBounds la in [0:*[;
+la.setEntryName("VirginConsolidationLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty stress pc_char;
+@PhysicalBounds pc_char in [0:*[;
+pc_char.setEntryName("CharacteristicPreConsolidationPressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴸʳ;
+Sᴸʳ.setEntryName("ResidualLiquidSaturation");
+
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴳʳ;
+Sᴳʳ.setEntryName("ResidualGasSaturation");
+
+@MaterialProperty real pᵇ;
+pᵇ.setEntryName("BubblePressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty real mⱽᴳ;
+mⱽᴳ.setEntryName("VanGenuchtenExponent_m");
+
+@LocalVariable bool withinElasticRange;
+@LocalVariable real M²;
+@LocalVariable real pc_min;
+@LocalVariable real rpc_min;
+@LocalVariable real K;
+@LocalVariable StressStensor σ₀;
+@LocalVariable StiffnessTensor ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ;
+
+@TangentOperatorBlocks{∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ, ∂σ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ, ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ, ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ};
+
+@InitializeLocalVariables
+{
+    const auto Sₑ = [&](const auto pᶜᵃᵖ) {
+        return std::pow(
+            std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ, 1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ)) + 1.0, -mⱽᴳ);
+    };
+
+    const auto S = Sₑ(-(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ)) * (1.0 - Sᴳʳ - Sᴸʳ) + Sᴸʳ;
+    Sᴸ = std::clamp(S, Sᴸʳ, 1.0 - Sᴳʳ);
+
+    tfel::raise_if(la < ka, "Invalid parameters: la<ka");
+    M² = M * M;
+
+    εᵉˡ = (1.0 + ν) / young * σ - ν / young * trace(σ) * I₂;
+    σ₀ = σ;
+
+    rpc = pc / young;
+    pc_min = 1e-15 * pc_char;
+    rpc_min = pc_min / young;
+
+    K = young / (3.0 * (1.0 - 2.0 * ν));
+    ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ = young / (1.0 + ν) * Stensor4::K() + K * Stensor4::IxI();
+
+    const auto σᵉˡ = σ₀ + ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ * Δεᵗᵒ;
+    const auto sᵉˡ = deviator(σᵉˡ);
+    const auto qᵉˡ = sqrt(1.5 * sᵉˡ | sᵉˡ);
+    const auto pᵉˡ = -trace(σᵉˡ) / 3.0 + pamb;
+    const auto fᵉˡ = qᵉˡ * qᵉˡ + M² * pᵉˡ * (pᵉˡ - pc);
+    withinElasticRange = fᵉˡ < 0;
+}
+
+@ComputeThermodynamicForces
+{
+    σ = σ₀ + θ * ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ * Δεᵉˡ;
+}
+
+@Integrator
+{
+    constexpr const auto Pr4 = Stensor4::K();
+    const auto the = vʳ / (la - ka);
+
+    if (withinElasticRange)
+    {
+        fεᵉˡ -= Δεᵗᵒ;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const auto epsr = strain(1.e-12);
+    const auto s = deviator(σ);
+    const auto q = sqrt(1.5 * s | s);
+    const auto p = -trace(σ) / 3.0 + pamb;
+
+    const auto rpc_new = rpc + θ * Δrpc;
+    const auto pc_new = rpc_new * young;
+
+    const auto f = q * q + M² * p * (p - pc_new);
+    const auto ∂f∕∂p = M² * (2.0 * p - pc_new);
+    const auto ∂f∕∂σ = eval(3.0 * s - ∂f∕∂p * I₂ / 3.0);
+    auto norm = sqrt(6.0 * q * q + ∂f∕∂p * ∂f∕∂p / 3.0);
+    norm = max(norm, epsr * young);
+    const auto n = ∂f∕∂σ / norm;
+    const auto ntr = -∂f∕∂p / norm;
+
+    const auto Δεᵖˡ = eval(ΔΛₚ * n);
+    const auto Δεᵖˡᵛ = trace(Δεᵖˡ);
+
+    const auto fchar = pc_char * young;
+
+    fεᵉˡ = Δεᵉˡ + Δεᵖˡ - Δεᵗᵒ;
+    fΛₚ = f / fchar;
+    frpc = Δrpc + Δεᵖˡᵛ * the * (rpc_new - rpc_min);
+
+    const auto ∂norm∕∂σ =
+        (9.0 * s - 2.0 * M² / 9.0 * ∂f∕∂p * I₂) / norm;
+    const auto ∂n∕∂Δεᵉˡ =
+        (3.0 * Pr4 + 2.0 * M² / 9.0 * (I₂ ⊗ I₂) - (n ⊗ ∂norm∕∂σ)) / norm *
+        ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ * θ;
+    const auto ∂n∕∂Δrpc =
+        (I₂ + ∂f∕∂p * n / norm) * M² / (3.0 * norm) * θ * young;
+    const auto ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ = the * (rpc_new - rpc_min);
+
+    ∂fεᵉˡ∕∂Δεᵉˡ += ΔΛₚ * ∂n∕∂Δεᵉˡ;
+    ∂fεᵉˡ∕∂ΔΛₚ = n;
+    ∂fεᵉˡ∕∂Δrpc = ΔΛₚ * ∂n∕∂Δrpc;
+
+    ∂fΛₚ∕∂Δεᵉˡ = (∂f∕∂σ | ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ) * θ / fchar;
+    ∂fΛₚ∕∂ΔΛₚ = strain(0);
+    ∂fΛₚ∕∂Δrpc = -M² * p * θ / fchar * young;
+
+    ∂frpc∕∂ΔΛₚ = ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ * ntr;
+    ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵉˡ = ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ * ΔΛₚ * (I₂ | ∂n∕∂Δεᵉˡ);
+    ∂frpc∕∂Δrpc =
+        1.0 + Δεᵖˡᵛ * the * θ + ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ * ΔΛₚ * trace(∂n∕∂Δrpc);
+}
+
+@ComputeFinalThermodynamicForces
+{
+    σ = σ₀ + ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ * Δεᵉˡ;
+}
+
+@UpdateAuxiliaryStateVariables
+{
+    pc += Δrpc * young;
+    εᵛₚₗ += trace(Δεᵗᵒ - Δεᵉˡ);
+    vʳ *= exp(trace(Δεᵗᵒ));
+}
+
+@AdditionalConvergenceChecks
+{
+    if (converged)
+    {
+        if (!withinElasticRange)
+        {
+            if (ΔΛₚ < 0)
+            {
+                converged = false;
+                withinElasticRange = true;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+@TangentOperator
+{
+    const auto ∂Sᴸ∕∂pᶜᵃᵖ = [&](const auto pᶜᵃᵖ) {
+        return (1.0 - Sᴳʳ - Sᴸʳ) *
+               (Sᴸ < (1.0 - Sᴳʳ) && Sᴸ > Sᴸʳ
+                    ? -mⱽᴳ / (pᵇ * (1.0 - mⱽᴳ)) *
+                          std::pow(std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ,
+                                            1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ)) +
+                                       1.0,
+                                   -mⱽᴳ - 1.0) *
+                          std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ,
+                                   1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ) - 1.0)
+                    : 0.0);
+    };
+
+    ∂σ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ = 0.0 * I₂;
+    ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ = 0.0 * I₂;
+    ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ = -∂Sᴸ∕∂pᶜᵃᵖ(-(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ));
+
+    if ((smt == ELASTIC) || (smt == SECANTOPERATOR))
+    {
+        ∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ = ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ;
+    }
+    else if (smt == CONSISTENTTANGENTOPERATOR)
+    {
+        Stensor4 Je;
+        getPartialJacobianInvert(Je);
+        ∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ = ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ * Je;
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/ModCamClay_semiExpl_coupled.mfront b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/ModCamClay_semiExpl_coupled.mfront
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..9367067e16
--- /dev/null
+++ b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/ModCamClay_semiExpl_coupled.mfront
@@ -0,0 +1,343 @@
+// DSL and behaviour declaration
+@DSL ImplicitGenericBehaviour;
+@Behaviour ModCamClay_semiExpl_coupled;
+@Author Aqeel Afzal Chaudhry, Christian Silbermann, Eric Simo, Miguel Mánica, Thomas Helfer, Thomas Nagel;
+@Date 01/09/2025;
+@Description{
+    The modified cam-clay model according to Callari (1998):
+    "A finite-strain cam-clay model in the framework of multiplicative elasto-plasticity"
+    but here in a consistent geometrically linear form (linearized volume ratio evolution)
+    semi-explicit due to explicit volume ratio update at the end of time step,
+    nonlinear hypoelastic behavior: pressure-dependent bulk modulus, constant Poisson ratio,
+    incremental formulation assuming constant elastic parameters over the time step,
+    normalized plastic flow direction, lower limit for a minimal pre-consolidation pressure, 
+    with hydraulic and thermal coupling, saturation dependent swelling,
+}
+
+@Theta 1.0;                     // time integration scheme
+@Epsilon 1e-14;                 // tolerance of local stress integration algorithm
+@MaximumNumberOfIterations 100;  // for local local stress integration algorithm
+@ModellingHypotheses{".+"};     // supporting all stress and strain states
+@Algorithm NewtonRaphson;       //_NumericalJacobian;_LevenbergMarquardt
+
+// Gradients and state variables
+@Gradient StrainStensor εᵗᵒ;
+εᵗᵒ.setGlossaryName("Strain");
+
+@ThermodynamicForce StressStensor σ;
+σ.setGlossaryName("Stress");
+
+@Gradient real pᴸᴿ;
+pᴸᴿ.setEntryName("LiquidPressure");
+
+@ThermodynamicForce real Sᴸ;
+Sᴸ.setEntryName("Saturation");
+
+@StateVariable StressStensor σˢʷ;
+σˢʷ.setEntryName("swelling_stress");
+
+@StateVariable StrainStensor εᵉˡ;
+εᵉˡ.setGlossaryName("ElasticStrain");
+
+@StateVariable real Λₚ;
+Λₚ.setGlossaryName("EquivalentPlasticStrain");
+
+@IntegrationVariable strain rpc;
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable stress pc;
+pc.setEntryName("PreConsolidationPressure");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real εᵛₚₗ;
+εᵛₚₗ.setEntryName("PlasticVolumetricStrain");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real vʳ;
+vʳ.setEntryName("VolumeRatio");
+
+
+@MaterialProperty real ν;
+ν.setGlossaryName("PoissonRatio");
+
+@MaterialProperty real M;
+M.setEntryName("CriticalStateLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real ka;
+ka.setEntryName("SwellingLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real la;
+la.setEntryName("VirginConsolidationLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty stress pc_char;
+pc_char.setEntryName("CharacteristicPreConsolidationPressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty real vʳ⁰;
+vʳ⁰.setEntryName("InitialVolumeRatio");
+
+@MaterialProperty real α;
+α.setGlossaryName("ThermalExpansion");
+@MaterialProperty real αᵇ;
+αᵇ.setEntryName("BiotCoefficient");
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴸʳ;
+Sᴸʳ.setEntryName("ResidualLiquidSaturation");
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴳʳ;
+Sᴳʳ.setEntryName("ResidualGasSaturation");
+@MaterialProperty real pᵇ;
+pᵇ.setEntryName("BubblePressure");
+@MaterialProperty real mⱽᴳ;
+mⱽᴳ.setEntryName("VanGenuchtenExponent_m");
+
+@MaterialProperty real bishop_type;
+bishop_type.setEntryName("BishopsModelType");
+
+@MaterialProperty real bishop_value;
+bishop_value.setEntryName("BishopsModelValue");
+
+// Swelling properties (SaturationDependentSwelling as in OGS) but isotropic for the time being:
+@MaterialProperty real pˢʷ;
+pˢʷ.setEntryName("SwellingPressures");
+@MaterialProperty real mˢʷ;
+mˢʷ.setEntryName("Exponents");
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴸₗ;
+Sᴸₗ.setEntryName("LowerSaturationLimit");
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴸₕ;
+Sᴸₕ.setEntryName("UpperSaturationLimit");
+
+// local variables
+@LocalVariable real K;
+@LocalVariable real φ;
+@LocalVariable real φ₀;
+@LocalVariable real ∂φ∕∂Sᴸ;
+@LocalVariable real Δpˢʷ;
+@LocalVariable real χ;
+@LocalVariable real χ₀;
+@LocalVariable real ∂χ∕∂Sᴸ;
+@LocalVariable StressStensor σ₀;
+@LocalVariable StiffnessTensor ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ;
+@LocalVariable bool withinElasticRange;
+@LocalVariable real M²;
+@LocalVariable real young;
+@LocalVariable real pc_min;
+@LocalVariable real rpc_min;
+
+//@TangentOperatorBlocks{∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ, ∂σ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ, ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ};
+@TangentOperatorBlocks{∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ, ∂σ∕∂ΔT, ∂σ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ, ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ};
+
+@InitializeLocalVariables
+{
+    // retention
+    const auto Sₑ = [&](const auto pᶜᵃᵖ) {
+        return std::pow(
+            std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ, 1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ)) + 1.0, -mⱽᴳ);
+    };
+    // previous
+    const double S₀ = Sₑ(-(pᴸᴿ)) ⋅ (1.0 - Sᴳʳ - Sᴸʳ) + Sᴸʳ;
+    const double Sᴸ₀ = std::clamp(S₀, Sᴸʳ, 1.0 - Sᴳʳ);
+    // new
+    const double S = Sₑ(-(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ)) ⋅ (1.0 - Sᴳʳ - Sᴸʳ) + Sᴸʳ;
+    Sᴸ = std::clamp(S, Sᴸʳ, 1.0 - Sᴳʳ);
+
+    // Bishop power law or cutoff
+    const int model_type = static_cast<int>(bishop_type);
+    if (model_type == 0) {
+        χ = std::pow(Sᴸ, bishop_value);
+        ∂χ∕∂Sᴸ = bishop_value ⋅ std::pow(Sᴸ, bishop_value - 1);
+        χ₀ = std::pow(Sᴸ₀, bishop_value);
+    }
+    else if (model_type == 1) {
+        const double S_cut = bishop_value;
+        if (Sᴸ < S_cut) {
+        χ = 0.0;
+        ∂χ∕∂Sᴸ = 0.0;
+        } else if (Sᴸ > 1.0) {
+        χ = 1.0;
+        ∂χ∕∂Sᴸ = 0.0;
+        } else {
+        const double denom = std::max(1e-15, 1.0 - S_cut);
+        χ = (Sᴸ - S_cut) / denom;
+        ∂χ∕∂Sᴸ = 1.0 / denom;
+        }
+        χ₀ = (Sᴸ₀ < S_cut) ? 0.0 :
+                (Sᴸ₀ > 1.0) ? 1.0 :
+                (Sᴸ₀ - S_cut) / std::max(1e-15, 1.0 - S_cut);
+    }
+    else {
+        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid BishopsModelType: must be 0 (power law) or 1 (cutoff).");
+    }
+    
+    // SaturationDependentSwelling
+    if (Sᴸ <= Sᴸₗ)
+    {
+        φ = 0.0;
+        ∂φ∕∂Sᴸ = 0.0;
+    }
+    else if (Sᴸ >= Sᴸₕ)
+    {
+        φ = 1.0;
+        ∂φ∕∂Sᴸ = 0.0;
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        const double normalized = (Sᴸ - Sᴸₗ) / (Sᴸₕ - Sᴸₗ);
+        φ = std::pow(normalized, mˢʷ);
+        ∂φ∕∂Sᴸ = mˢʷ / (Sᴸₕ - Sᴸₗ) ⋅ std::pow(normalized, mˢʷ - 1);
+    }
+
+    φ₀ = std::pow((Sᴸ₀ - Sᴸₗ) / (Sᴸₕ - Sᴸₗ) , mˢʷ);
+                                    
+    // Swelling stress contribution:
+    Δpˢʷ = pˢʷ ⋅ (φ - φ₀);   
+
+    tfel::raise_if(la < ka, "Invalid parameters: la<ka");
+    M² = M ⋅ M;
+    
+    // update σ₀ --> effective
+    σ₀ = σ + αᵇ ⋅ χ₀ ⋅ pᴸᴿ ⋅ I₂;
+
+    // compute elastic stiffness (constant during time step)
+    pc_min = 0.5e-8 ⋅ pc_char;
+    const auto p = -trace(σ₀) / 3;
+    K = vʳ⁰ / ka ⋅ max(p , pc_char);
+    const auto E = 3.0 ⋅ K ⋅ (1.0 - 2 ⋅ ν);
+
+    young = E;
+    rpc = pc / young;
+    rpc_min = pc_min / young;
+
+    // stress derivative
+    ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ = E / (1.0 + ν) ⋅ Stensor4::K() + K ⋅ Stensor4::IxI();
+
+    // elastic trial stress
+    const auto σᵉˡ = σ₀ + ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ ⋅ Δεᵗᵒ - 3 ⋅ K ⋅ α ⋅ ΔT ⋅ I₂ - Δpˢʷ ⋅ I₂;
+
+    // elastic estimators
+    const auto sᵉˡ = deviator(σᵉˡ);
+    const auto qᵉˡ = sqrt(1.5 ⋅ sᵉˡ | sᵉˡ);
+    const auto pᵉˡ = -trace(σᵉˡ) / 3;
+
+    const auto pcᵉˡ = pc;
+    const auto fᵉˡ = qᵉˡ ⋅ qᵉˡ + M² ⋅ pᵉˡ ⋅ (pᵉˡ - pcᵉˡ);
+    withinElasticRange = fᵉˡ < 0;
+}
+
+@ComputeThermodynamicForces{
+    σ = σ₀ + θ ⋅ ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ ⋅ Δεᵉˡ - 3 ⋅ K ⋅ α ⋅ ΔT ⋅ I₂ - Δpˢʷ ⋅ I₂;
+}
+
+@Integrator
+{
+    constexpr const auto Pr4 = Stensor4::K();
+    const auto the = vʳ⁰ / (la - ka);
+    // elastic range:
+    if (withinElasticRange)
+    {
+        fεᵉˡ -= Δεᵗᵒ;
+        //σ = σ₀ + ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ ⋅ Δεᵉˡ - 3 ⋅ K ⋅ α ⋅ ΔT ⋅ I₂ - αᵇ ⋅ χ ⋅ (pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ) ⋅ I₂ - Δpˢʷ ⋅ I₂;
+        return true;
+    }
+    // plastic range:
+    const auto epsr = strain(1.e-12);
+    // calculate invariants from current stress sig
+    const auto s = deviator(σ);
+    const auto q = sqrt(1.5 ⋅ s | s);
+    const auto p = -trace(σ) / 3;
+    // update the internal (state) variables (rpc holds the old value!)
+    const auto rpc_new = rpc + θ ⋅ Δrpc;
+    const auto pc_new = rpc_new ⋅ young;
+    // calculate the direction of plastic flow
+    const auto f = q ⋅ q + M² ⋅ p ⋅ (p - pc_new);
+    const auto ∂f∕∂p = M² ⋅ (2 ⋅ p - pc_new);
+    const auto ∂f∕∂σ = eval(3 ⋅ s - ∂f∕∂p ⋅ I₂ / 3);
+    auto norm = sqrt(6 ⋅ q ⋅ q + ∂f∕∂p ⋅ ∂f∕∂p / 3);  // = sqrt(∂f∕∂σ|∂f∕∂σ);
+    norm = max(norm, epsr ⋅ young);
+    const auto n = ∂f∕∂σ / norm;
+    const auto ntr = -∂f∕∂p / norm;
+    // plastic strain and volumetric part
+    const auto Δεᵖˡ = eval(ΔΛₚ ⋅ n);
+    const auto Δεᵖˡᵛ = trace(Δεᵖˡ);
+
+    const auto fchar = pc_char ⋅ young;
+
+    // residual
+    fεᵉˡ = Δεᵉˡ + Δεᵖˡ - Δεᵗᵒ;
+    fΛₚ = f / fchar;
+    frpc = Δrpc + Δεᵖˡᵛ ⋅ the ⋅ (rpc_new - rpc_min);
+
+    // auxiliary derivatives
+    const auto ∂norm∕∂σ = (9 ⋅ s - 2 ⋅ M² / 9 ⋅ ∂f∕∂p ⋅ I₂) / norm;
+    const auto ∂n∕∂Δεᵉˡ = (3 ⋅ Pr4 + 2 ⋅ M² / 9 ⋅ (I₂ ⊗ I₂) - (n ⊗ ∂norm∕∂σ)) / norm ⋅ ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ ⋅ θ;
+    const auto ∂n∕∂Δrpc = (I₂ + ∂f∕∂p ⋅ n / norm) ⋅ M² / (3 ⋅ norm) ⋅ θ ⋅ young;
+    const auto ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ = the ⋅ (rpc_new - rpc_min);
+
+    // jacobian (all other parts are zero)
+    ∂fεᵉˡ∕∂Δεᵉˡ += ΔΛₚ ⋅ ∂n∕∂Δεᵉˡ;
+    ∂fεᵉˡ∕∂ΔΛₚ = n;
+    ∂fεᵉˡ∕∂Δrpc = ΔΛₚ ⋅ ∂n∕∂Δrpc;
+
+    ∂fΛₚ∕∂Δεᵉˡ = (∂f∕∂σ | ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ) ⋅ θ / fchar;    // in case of problems with zero use:
+    ∂fΛₚ∕∂ΔΛₚ  = strain(0);                         // (q<epsr) ? strain(1) : strain(0);
+    ∂fΛₚ∕∂Δrpc = -M² ⋅ p ⋅ θ / fchar ⋅ young;
+
+    ∂frpc∕∂ΔΛₚ = ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ ⋅ ntr;
+    ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵉˡ = ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ ⋅ ΔΛₚ ⋅ (I₂ | ∂n∕∂Δεᵉˡ);
+    ∂frpc∕∂Δrpc = 1 + Δεᵖˡᵛ ⋅ the ⋅ θ + ∂frpc∕∂Δεᵖˡᵛ ⋅ ΔΛₚ ⋅ trace(∂n∕∂Δrpc);
+}
+
+@ComputeFinalThermodynamicForces{
+    σ = σ₀ + ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ ⋅ Δεᵉˡ - 3 ⋅ K ⋅ α ⋅ ΔT ⋅ I₂ - αᵇ ⋅ χ ⋅ pᴸᴿ ⋅ I₂ - Δpˢʷ ⋅ I₂;
+}
+
+// explicit treatment as long as change of vʳ (or e) during time increment is small
+@UpdateAuxiliaryStateVariables
+{
+    σˢʷ -= Δpˢʷ ⋅ I₂;
+    pc += Δrpc ⋅ young;
+    εᵛₚₗ += trace(Δεᵗᵒ - Δεᵉˡ - α ⋅ ΔT ⋅ I₂); //Thermal strain subtracted
+    vʳ += vʳ⁰ ⋅ trace(Δεᵗᵒ - α ⋅ ΔT ⋅ I₂); //Thermal strain subtracted
+}
+
+@AdditionalConvergenceChecks
+{
+    if (converged)
+    {
+        if (!withinElasticRange)
+        {
+            if (ΔΛₚ < 0)
+            {
+                converged = false;
+                withinElasticRange = true;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+@TangentOperator // because no Brick StandardElasticity
+{
+    const auto ∂Sᴸ∕∂pᶜᵃᵖ = [&](const auto pᶜᵃᵖ) {
+        return (1.0 - Sᴳʳ - Sᴸʳ)⋅(Sᴸ < (1 - Sᴳʳ) && Sᴸ > Sᴸʳ
+                    ? -mⱽᴳ / (pᵇ ⋅ (1 - mⱽᴳ)) ⋅ std::pow(
+                                std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ,
+                                        1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ)) +
+                                    1.0,
+                                -mⱽᴳ - 1) ⋅ std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ,
+                                                    1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ) - 1.0)
+                    : 0.);
+    };
+    ∂σ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ  = - αᵇ ⋅ (χ - (pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ) ⋅ ∂χ∕∂Sᴸ ⋅ ∂Sᴸ∕∂pᶜᵃᵖ(-(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ))) ⋅ I₂ + pˢʷ ⋅ ∂φ∕∂Sᴸ ⋅ ∂Sᴸ∕∂pᶜᵃᵖ(-(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ)) ⋅ I₂;
+    ∂σ∕∂ΔT    = -3 ⋅ K ⋅ α ⋅ I₂;
+    ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ = - ∂Sᴸ∕∂pᶜᵃᵖ( -(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ));
+    
+    if ((smt == ELASTIC) || (smt == SECANTOPERATOR))
+    {
+        ∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ = ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ;
+    }
+    else if (smt == CONSISTENTTANGENTOPERATOR)
+    {
+        Stensor4 Je;
+        getPartialJacobianInvert(Je);
+        ∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ = ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ ⋅ Je;
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge.mfront b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge.mfront
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..7823db047e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge.mfront
@@ -0,0 +1,587 @@
+@DSL DefaultGenericBehaviour;
+@Behaviour RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge;
+@Author OpenGeoSys Community;
+@Date 2026 / 03 / 24;
+@Description {
+Reduced dsm_micromacro-aligned RichardsMechanics bridge for the verified shared
+pressure-history boundary. This bridge replaces the earlier logistic pressure
+surrogate by a local microstate update with phi_m := n_l, a reduced micro-liquid
+EOS, a van-der-Waals micro potential, and an isotropic swelling-stress update.
+The verified regression boundary of this step is the nonnegative pressure path
+used by the committed dsm_micromacro overlap-transfer baseline.
+}
+
+@Gradient StrainStensor eps_to;
+eps_to.setGlossaryName("Strain");
+
+@Gradient real p_LR;
+p_LR.setEntryName("LiquidPressure");
+
+@Flux StressStensor sigma;
+sigma.setGlossaryName("Stress");
+
+@Flux real S_L;
+S_L.setEntryName("Saturation");
+
+@TangentOperatorBlocks{∂sigma∕∂Δeps_to, ∂sigma∕∂Δp_LR, ∂S_L∕∂Δeps_to,
+                       ∂S_L∕∂Δp_LR};
+
+@MaterialProperty stress E;
+E.setGlossaryName("YoungModulus");
+@MaterialProperty real nu;
+nu.setGlossaryName("PoissonRatio");
+
+@MaterialProperty real swelling_slope;
+swelling_slope.setEntryName("SwellingSlope");
+@MaterialProperty real mass_exchange_coefficient;
+mass_exchange_coefficient.setEntryName("MassExchangeCoefficient");
+@MaterialProperty real rho_LR_ref;
+rho_LR_ref.setEntryName("ReferenceLiquidDensityMacro");
+@MaterialProperty real rho_l0;
+rho_l0.setEntryName("ReferenceLiquidDensityMicro");
+@MaterialProperty real rho_SR;
+rho_SR.setEntryName("ReferenceDensitySolid");
+@MaterialProperty real density_a;
+density_a.setEntryName("MicroLiquidDensityA");
+@MaterialProperty real density_b;
+density_b.setEntryName("MicroLiquidDensityB");
+@MaterialProperty real hamaker_constant;
+hamaker_constant.setEntryName("HamakerConstant");
+@MaterialProperty real specific_surface;
+specific_surface.setEntryName("SpecificSurface");
+@MaterialProperty real phi0;
+phi0.setEntryName("InitialPorosity");
+@MaterialProperty real area_factor_tuller;
+area_factor_tuller.setEntryName("AreaFactorTuller");
+@MaterialProperty real pore_area_shape_factor_tuller;
+pore_area_shape_factor_tuller.setEntryName("PoreAreaShapeFactorTuller");
+@MaterialProperty real characteristic_pore_size;
+characteristic_pore_size.setEntryName("CharacteristicPoreSize");
+@MaterialProperty real surface_tension;
+surface_tension.setEntryName("SurfaceTension");
+
+@StateVariable real n_l;
+n_l.setEntryName("n_l");
+@StateVariable real rho_lR;
+rho_lR.setEntryName("rho_lR");
+@StateVariable real epsilon_sw;
+epsilon_sw.setEntryName("epsilon_sw");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real phi_m;
+phi_m.setEntryName("phi_m");
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real phi_M;
+phi_M.setEntryName("phi_M");
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real mu_lR_value;
+mu_lR_value.setEntryName("mu_lR");
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real rho_l_hat_value;
+rho_l_hat_value.setEntryName("rho_l_hat");
+
+@ProvidesTangentOperator;
+@Integrator {
+  constexpr const auto pi = 3.14159265358979323846;
+  constexpr const auto pressure_tolerance = 1e-12;
+  constexpr const auto minimum_n_l = 1e-14;
+  constexpr const auto minimum_density_gap = 1e-12;
+  // Finite-difference tangent probes around the benchmark equilibrium hit
+  // round-off before 1e-12, which can trigger a spurious line-search failure
+  // in an already converged microstate solve.
+  constexpr const auto newton_tolerance = 1e-11;
+  constexpr const auto max_iterations = 64;
+
+  tfel::raise_if(phi0 <= 0.0 || phi0 >= 1.0,
+                 "Invalid parameter: InitialPorosity must lie in (0,1).");
+  tfel::raise_if(rho_LR_ref <= 0.0 || rho_l0 <= 0.0 || rho_SR <= 0.0,
+                 "Invalid density parameter: all reference densities must be positive.");
+  tfel::raise_if(specific_surface <= 0.0,
+                 "Invalid parameter: SpecificSurface must be positive.");
+  tfel::raise_if(characteristic_pore_size <= 0.0,
+                 "Invalid parameter: CharacteristicPoreSize must be positive.");
+  tfel::raise_if(surface_tension <= 0.0,
+                 "Invalid parameter: SurfaceTension must be positive.");
+
+  const auto lambda = computeLambda(E, nu);
+  const auto mu = computeMu(E, nu);
+  const auto bulk_modulus = E / (3.0 * (1.0 - 2.0 * nu));
+  const auto p = p_LR + Δp_LR;
+  const auto delta_epsilon_v = trace(Δeps_to);
+  const auto zero_dt = std::abs(dt) < 1e-15;
+  const auto n_s = 1.0 - phi0;
+  const auto n_l_prev = n_l;
+  const auto rho_lR_prev = rho_lR;
+  const auto phi_m_prev = n_l_prev;
+  const auto previous_mass = n_l_prev * rho_lR_prev;
+
+  const auto saturation_from_pressure = [&](const auto p_arg) {
+    if (p_arg < -pressure_tolerance)
+    {
+      const auto capillary_prefactor =
+          4.0 * pore_area_shape_factor_tuller * surface_tension * surface_tension /
+          (area_factor_tuller * characteristic_pore_size * characteristic_pore_size);
+      const auto capillary_term = capillary_prefactor / (p_arg * p_arg);
+      return 1.0 - std::exp(-capillary_term);
+    }
+    return 1.0;
+  };
+
+  const auto mu_macro_from_pressure = [&](const auto p_arg,
+                                          const auto rho_macro_arg) {
+    const auto rho_macro_safe =
+        std::max(rho_macro_arg, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+    return p_arg > -pressure_tolerance ? 0.0 : p_arg / rho_macro_safe;
+  };
+
+  const auto omega_from_state = [&](const auto n_l_arg, const auto rho_lR_arg) {
+    return n_l_arg * rho_lR_arg / (n_s * rho_SR);
+  };
+
+  const auto rho_micro_eos = [&](const auto n_l_arg, const auto rho_lR_arg) {
+    const auto omega = std::max(omega_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg), minimum_n_l);
+    return rho_l0 * std::exp(-density_a * std::pow(omega, density_b)) + rho_LR_ref;
+  };
+
+  const auto mu_micro_from_state = [&](const auto n_l_arg, const auto rho_lR_arg) {
+    const auto omega = std::max(omega_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg), minimum_n_l);
+    return (hamaker_constant * rho_lR_arg * rho_lR_arg * rho_lR_arg / (6.0 * pi)) *
+           std::pow(specific_surface / omega, 3.0);
+  };
+
+  const auto solve_microstate = [&](const auto p_arg,
+                                    const auto delta_epsilon_v_arg,
+                                    const auto n_l_prev_arg,
+                                    const auto rho_lR_prev_arg,
+                                    double& n_l_out,
+                                    double& rho_lR_out,
+                                    double& mu_lR_out,
+                                    double& rho_l_hat_out) {
+    const auto rho_macro_step =
+        std::max(rho_lR_prev_arg, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+    auto n_l_trial = std::max(n_l_prev_arg, minimum_n_l);
+    auto rho_lR_trial = std::max(rho_lR_prev_arg, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+    auto converged = false;
+
+    const auto evaluate = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                              const auto rho_lR_arg,
+                              double& residual_1,
+      double& residual_2,
+      double& mu_lR_arg,
+      double& rho_l_hat_arg) {
+      const auto mu_LR_arg = mu_macro_from_pressure(p_arg, rho_macro_step);
+      mu_lR_arg = mu_micro_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg);
+      rho_l_hat_arg = mass_exchange_coefficient * (mu_LR_arg - mu_lR_arg);
+      residual_1 = n_l_arg * rho_lR_arg - previous_mass - dt * rho_l_hat_arg -
+                   n_l_arg * rho_lR_arg * delta_epsilon_v_arg;
+      residual_2 = rho_lR_arg - rho_micro_eos(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg);
+    };
+
+    const auto solve_rho_for_n_l = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                                       const auto rho_initial_guess,
+                                       double& rho_lR_out_arg) {
+      auto rho_lR_trial_local =
+          std::max(rho_initial_guess, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+
+      for (unsigned int iteration = 0; iteration < 4 * max_iterations;
+           ++iteration)
+      {
+        const auto rho_candidate = rho_micro_eos(n_l_arg, rho_lR_trial_local);
+        const auto rho_change = std::abs(rho_candidate - rho_lR_trial_local);
+        rho_lR_trial_local = std::max(rho_candidate, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+
+        if (rho_change <
+            newton_tolerance * std::max(1.0, std::abs(rho_lR_trial_local)))
+        {
+          rho_lR_out_arg = rho_lR_trial_local;
+          return true;
+        }
+      }
+
+      rho_lR_out_arg = rho_lR_trial_local;
+      return false;
+    };
+
+    const auto evaluate_reduced = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                                      const auto rho_initial_guess,
+                                      double& residual_1,
+                                      double& rho_lR_arg,
+                                      double& mu_lR_arg,
+                                      double& rho_l_hat_arg) {
+      const auto rho_converged =
+          solve_rho_for_n_l(n_l_arg, rho_initial_guess, rho_lR_arg);
+      const auto mu_LR_arg = mu_macro_from_pressure(p_arg, rho_macro_step);
+      mu_lR_arg = mu_micro_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg);
+      rho_l_hat_arg = mass_exchange_coefficient * (mu_LR_arg - mu_lR_arg);
+      residual_1 =
+          n_l_arg * rho_lR_arg - previous_mass - dt * rho_l_hat_arg -
+          n_l_arg * rho_lR_arg * delta_epsilon_v_arg;
+      return rho_converged;
+    };
+
+    const auto solve_microstate_bracketed =
+        [&](double& n_l_bracketed_out,
+            double& rho_lR_bracketed_out,
+            double& mu_lR_bracketed_out,
+            double& rho_l_hat_bracketed_out) {
+          constexpr const auto bracket_scan_points = 256u;
+          auto n_l_lo = minimum_n_l;
+          auto n_l_hi = std::max(phi0, std::max(n_l_prev_arg, minimum_n_l * 10.0));
+
+          double residual_lo = 0.0;
+          double residual_hi = 0.0;
+          double rho_lo = 0.0;
+          double rho_hi = 0.0;
+          double mu_lo = 0.0;
+          double mu_hi = 0.0;
+          double rho_hat_lo = 0.0;
+          double rho_hat_hi = 0.0;
+
+          auto bracket_ok =
+              evaluate_reduced(n_l_lo, rho_lR_prev_arg, residual_lo, rho_lo,
+                               mu_lo, rho_hat_lo) &&
+              evaluate_reduced(n_l_hi, rho_lR_prev_arg, residual_hi, rho_hi,
+                               mu_hi, rho_hat_hi);
+
+          if (!bracket_ok)
+          {
+            return false;
+          }
+
+          if (residual_lo * residual_hi > 0.0)
+          {
+            const auto log_n_l_min = std::log10(minimum_n_l);
+            const auto log_n_l_max = std::log10(n_l_hi);
+            auto previous_n_l = n_l_lo;
+            auto previous_residual = residual_lo;
+            auto previous_rho = rho_lo;
+            auto previous_mu = mu_lo;
+            auto previous_rho_hat = rho_hat_lo;
+            auto found_bracket = false;
+
+            for (unsigned int i = 1; i <= bracket_scan_points; ++i)
+            {
+              const auto log_n_l =
+                  log_n_l_min +
+                  (log_n_l_max - log_n_l_min) *
+                      (static_cast<double>(i) / bracket_scan_points);
+              const auto n_l_candidate = std::pow(10.0, log_n_l);
+
+              double residual_candidate = 0.0;
+              double rho_candidate = 0.0;
+              double mu_candidate = 0.0;
+              double rho_hat_candidate = 0.0;
+              if (!evaluate_reduced(n_l_candidate, rho_lR_prev_arg,
+                                    residual_candidate, rho_candidate,
+                                    mu_candidate, rho_hat_candidate))
+              {
+                return false;
+              }
+
+              if (previous_residual * residual_candidate <= 0.0)
+              {
+                n_l_lo = previous_n_l;
+                residual_lo = previous_residual;
+                rho_lo = previous_rho;
+                mu_lo = previous_mu;
+                rho_hat_lo = previous_rho_hat;
+
+                n_l_hi = n_l_candidate;
+                residual_hi = residual_candidate;
+                rho_hi = rho_candidate;
+                mu_hi = mu_candidate;
+                rho_hat_hi = rho_hat_candidate;
+                found_bracket = true;
+                break;
+              }
+
+              previous_n_l = n_l_candidate;
+              previous_residual = residual_candidate;
+              previous_rho = rho_candidate;
+              previous_mu = mu_candidate;
+              previous_rho_hat = rho_hat_candidate;
+            }
+
+            if (!found_bracket)
+            {
+              return false;
+            }
+          }
+
+          for (unsigned int iteration = 0; iteration < 4 * max_iterations;
+               ++iteration)
+          {
+            const auto n_l_mid = 0.5 * (n_l_lo + n_l_hi);
+            double residual_mid = 0.0;
+            double rho_mid = 0.0;
+            double mu_mid = 0.0;
+            double rho_hat_mid = 0.0;
+
+            if (!evaluate_reduced(n_l_mid, rho_lR_prev_arg, residual_mid,
+                                  rho_mid, mu_mid, rho_hat_mid))
+            {
+              return false;
+            }
+
+            if (std::abs(residual_mid) < newton_tolerance ||
+                std::abs(n_l_hi - n_l_lo) <
+                    newton_tolerance * std::max(1.0, std::abs(n_l_mid)))
+            {
+              n_l_bracketed_out = n_l_mid;
+              rho_lR_bracketed_out = rho_mid;
+              mu_lR_bracketed_out = mu_mid;
+              rho_l_hat_bracketed_out = rho_hat_mid;
+              return true;
+            }
+
+            if (residual_lo * residual_mid <= 0.0)
+            {
+              n_l_hi = n_l_mid;
+              residual_hi = residual_mid;
+            }
+            else
+            {
+              n_l_lo = n_l_mid;
+              residual_lo = residual_mid;
+            }
+          }
+
+          const auto n_l_mid = 0.5 * (n_l_lo + n_l_hi);
+          double residual_mid = 0.0;
+          double rho_mid = 0.0;
+          double mu_mid = 0.0;
+          double rho_hat_mid = 0.0;
+          if (!evaluate_reduced(n_l_mid, rho_lR_prev_arg, residual_mid,
+                                rho_mid, mu_mid, rho_hat_mid))
+          {
+            return false;
+          }
+
+          n_l_bracketed_out = n_l_mid;
+          rho_lR_bracketed_out = rho_mid;
+          mu_lR_bracketed_out = mu_mid;
+          rho_l_hat_bracketed_out = rho_hat_mid;
+          return true;
+        };
+
+    for (unsigned int iteration = 0; iteration < max_iterations; ++iteration)
+    {
+      double residual_1 = 0.0;
+      double residual_2 = 0.0;
+      double mu_lR_trial = 0.0;
+      double rho_l_hat_trial = 0.0;
+      evaluate(n_l_trial, rho_lR_trial, residual_1, residual_2, mu_lR_trial,
+               rho_l_hat_trial);
+
+      const auto residual_norm = std::abs(residual_1) + std::abs(residual_2);
+      if (residual_norm < newton_tolerance)
+      {
+        n_l_out = n_l_trial;
+        rho_lR_out = rho_lR_trial;
+        mu_lR_out = mu_lR_trial;
+        rho_l_hat_out = rho_l_hat_trial;
+        converged = true;
+        break;
+      }
+
+      const auto h_n_l = std::max(1e-8 * std::abs(n_l_trial), 1e-10);
+      const auto h_rho = std::max(1e-8 * std::abs(rho_lR_trial), 1e-8);
+
+      double residual_1_n = 0.0;
+      double residual_2_n = 0.0;
+      double residual_1_rho = 0.0;
+      double residual_2_rho = 0.0;
+      double dummy_1 = 0.0;
+      double dummy_2 = 0.0;
+      evaluate(n_l_trial + h_n_l, rho_lR_trial, residual_1_n, residual_2_n,
+               dummy_1, dummy_2);
+      evaluate(n_l_trial, rho_lR_trial + h_rho, residual_1_rho, residual_2_rho,
+               dummy_1, dummy_2);
+
+      const auto j11 = (residual_1_n - residual_1) / h_n_l;
+      const auto j21 = (residual_2_n - residual_2) / h_n_l;
+      const auto j12 = (residual_1_rho - residual_1) / h_rho;
+      const auto j22 = (residual_2_rho - residual_2) / h_rho;
+      const auto determinant = j11 * j22 - j12 * j21;
+      tfel::raise_if(std::abs(determinant) < 1e-24,
+                     "DSMMicroMacro bridge microstate Newton system became singular.");
+
+      const auto delta_n_l = (-residual_1 * j22 + j12 * residual_2) / determinant;
+      const auto delta_rho = (j21 * residual_1 - j11 * residual_2) / determinant;
+
+      auto damping = 1.0;
+      auto accepted = false;
+      while (damping > 1e-6)
+      {
+        const auto n_l_candidate =
+            std::max(n_l_trial + damping * delta_n_l, minimum_n_l);
+        const auto rho_candidate =
+            std::max(rho_lR_trial + damping * delta_rho,
+                     rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+
+        double candidate_residual_1 = 0.0;
+        double candidate_residual_2 = 0.0;
+        double dummy_mu = 0.0;
+        double dummy_rho_hat = 0.0;
+        evaluate(n_l_candidate, rho_candidate, candidate_residual_1,
+                 candidate_residual_2, dummy_mu, dummy_rho_hat);
+        const auto candidate_norm =
+            std::abs(candidate_residual_1) + std::abs(candidate_residual_2);
+
+        if (candidate_norm < residual_norm)
+        {
+          n_l_trial = n_l_candidate;
+          rho_lR_trial = rho_candidate;
+          accepted = true;
+          break;
+        }
+        damping *= 0.5;
+      }
+
+      if (!accepted)
+      {
+        if (solve_microstate_bracketed(n_l_out, rho_lR_out, mu_lR_out,
+                                       rho_l_hat_out))
+        {
+          converged = true;
+          break;
+        }
+        tfel::raise_if(true,
+                       "DSMMicroMacro bridge microstate Newton line search failed.");
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (!converged)
+    {
+      if (solve_microstate_bracketed(n_l_out, rho_lR_out, mu_lR_out,
+                                     rho_l_hat_out))
+      {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      tfel::raise_if(true,
+                     "DSMMicroMacro bridge microstate Newton solve did not converge.");
+    }
+  };
+
+  double n_l_trial = n_l_prev;
+  double rho_lR_trial = rho_lR_prev;
+  double mu_lR_trial = mu_micro_from_state(n_l_prev, rho_lR_prev);
+  double rho_l_hat_trial =
+      mass_exchange_coefficient *
+      (mu_macro_from_pressure(p, rho_lR_prev) - mu_lR_trial);
+  if (!zero_dt)
+  {
+    solve_microstate(p, delta_epsilon_v, n_l_prev, rho_lR_prev, n_l_trial,
+                     rho_lR_trial, mu_lR_trial, rho_l_hat_trial);
+  }
+
+  const auto phi_m_trial = n_l_trial;
+  const auto phi_M_trial = phi0 - phi_m_trial;
+  const auto delta_epsilon_sw = swelling_slope * (phi_m_trial - phi_m_prev);
+
+  sigma = sigma + lambda * trace(Δeps_to) * I₂ + 2.0 * mu * Δeps_to -
+          bulk_modulus * delta_epsilon_sw * I₂;
+  S_L = saturation_from_pressure(p);
+
+  n_l = n_l_trial;
+  rho_lR = rho_lR_trial;
+  epsilon_sw = epsilon_sw + delta_epsilon_sw;
+  phi_m = phi_m_trial;
+  phi_M = phi_M_trial;
+  mu_lR_value = mu_lR_trial;
+  rho_l_hat_value = rho_l_hat_trial;
+
+  if (computeTangentOperator_)
+  {
+    ∂sigma∕∂Δeps_to = lambda * (I₂ ⊗ I₂) + 2.0 * mu * I₄;
+    ∂S_L∕∂Δeps_to = 0.0 * I₂;
+
+    if (zero_dt)
+    {
+      if (p > -pressure_tolerance)
+      {
+        ∂sigma∕∂Δp_LR = 0.0 * I₂;
+        ∂S_L∕∂Δp_LR = 0.0;
+      }
+      else
+      {
+        const auto dp_fd = std::max(1e-6, std::abs(p) * 1e-6);
+        const auto dS_dp =
+            (saturation_from_pressure(p + dp_fd) - saturation_from_pressure(p - dp_fd)) /
+            (2.0 * dp_fd);
+        ∂sigma∕∂Δp_LR = 0.0 * I₂;
+        ∂S_L∕∂Δp_LR = dS_dp;
+      }
+    }
+    else
+    {
+      const auto deps_v_fd = std::max(1e-8, std::abs(delta_epsilon_v) * 1e-6 + 1e-8);
+      double n_l_eps_plus = 0.0;
+      double rho_lR_eps_plus = 0.0;
+      double mu_lR_eps_plus = 0.0;
+      double rho_l_hat_eps_plus = 0.0;
+      double n_l_eps_minus = 0.0;
+      double rho_lR_eps_minus = 0.0;
+      double mu_lR_eps_minus = 0.0;
+      double rho_l_hat_eps_minus = 0.0;
+
+      solve_microstate(p, delta_epsilon_v + deps_v_fd, n_l_prev, rho_lR_prev,
+                       n_l_eps_plus, rho_lR_eps_plus, mu_lR_eps_plus,
+                       rho_l_hat_eps_plus);
+      solve_microstate(p, delta_epsilon_v - deps_v_fd, n_l_prev, rho_lR_prev,
+                       n_l_eps_minus, rho_lR_eps_minus, mu_lR_eps_minus,
+                       rho_l_hat_eps_minus);
+
+      const auto dn_l_dtrace_eps =
+          (n_l_eps_plus - n_l_eps_minus) / (2.0 * deps_v_fd);
+      ∂sigma∕∂Δeps_to = ∂sigma∕∂Δeps_to -
+                        (bulk_modulus * swelling_slope * dn_l_dtrace_eps) *
+                            (I₂ ⊗ I₂);
+
+      if (p > -pressure_tolerance)
+      {
+        ∂sigma∕∂Δp_LR = 0.0 * I₂;
+        ∂S_L∕∂Δp_LR = 0.0;
+      }
+      else
+      {
+        const auto dp_fd = std::max(1e-6, std::abs(p) * 1e-6);
+        double n_l_plus = 0.0;
+        double rho_lR_plus = 0.0;
+        double mu_lR_plus = 0.0;
+        double rho_l_hat_plus = 0.0;
+        double n_l_minus = 0.0;
+        double rho_lR_minus = 0.0;
+        double mu_lR_minus = 0.0;
+        double rho_l_hat_minus = 0.0;
+
+        solve_microstate(p + dp_fd, delta_epsilon_v, n_l_prev, rho_lR_prev,
+                         n_l_plus, rho_lR_plus, mu_lR_plus, rho_l_hat_plus);
+        solve_microstate(p - dp_fd, delta_epsilon_v, n_l_prev, rho_lR_prev,
+                         n_l_minus, rho_lR_minus, mu_lR_minus, rho_l_hat_minus);
+
+        const auto dS_dp =
+            (saturation_from_pressure(p + dp_fd) - saturation_from_pressure(p - dp_fd)) /
+            (2.0 * dp_fd);
+        const auto dn_l_dp = (n_l_plus - n_l_minus) / (2.0 * dp_fd);
+
+        ∂sigma∕∂Δp_LR = -(bulk_modulus * swelling_slope * dn_l_dp) * I₂;
+        ∂S_L∕∂Δp_LR = dS_dp;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+@UpdateAuxiliaryStateVariables
+{
+  constexpr const auto pressure_tolerance = 1e-12;
+  constexpr const auto minimum_n_l = 1e-14;
+  constexpr const auto pi = 3.14159265358979323846;
+
+  const auto n_s = 1.0 - phi0;
+  const auto omega = std::max(n_l * rho_lR / (n_s * rho_SR), minimum_n_l);
+  phi_m = n_l;
+  phi_M = phi0 - n_l;
+  mu_lR_value = (hamaker_constant * rho_lR * rho_lR * rho_lR / (6.0 * pi)) *
+                std::pow(specific_surface / omega, 3.0);
+  const auto rho_macro = std::max(rho_lR, rho_LR_ref + 1e-12);
+  const auto mu_LR = p_LR > -pressure_tolerance ? 0.0 : p_LR / rho_macro;
+  rho_l_hat_value = mass_exchange_coefficient * (mu_LR - mu_lR_value);
+}
diff --git a/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge_MCC.mfront b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge_MCC.mfront
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..e95ec4a5df
--- /dev/null
+++ b/MaterialLib/SolidModels/MFront/RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge_MCC.mfront
@@ -0,0 +1,1267 @@
+@DSL ImplicitGenericBehaviour;
+@Behaviour RichardsMechanicsDSMMicroMacroBridge_MCC;
+@Author OpenGeoSys Community;
+@Date 27 / 03 / 2026;
+@Description{
+    Pressure-coupled RichardsMechanics bridge that keeps the verified
+    ModCamClay_semiExpl_constE mechanical and saturation surface, while also
+    carrying the dsm_micromacro microstate variables n_l, rho_lR, epsilon_sw, phi_m,
+    phi_M, mu_lR, rho_l_hat, phi, n_S, n_L, rho_LR, omega_l,
+    delta_epsilon_sw, and sigma_S as persistent dsm_micromacro support state. The
+    returned saturation matches either the verified MCC bridge or, when
+    explicitly enabled, the dsm_micromacro Tuller law. The returned effective stress
+    also includes the dsm_micromacro isotropic swelling correction driven by the
+    updated microstate.
+}
+
+@Theta 1.0;
+@Epsilon 1e-14;
+@MaximumNumberOfIterations 200;
+@ModellingHypotheses{".+"};
+@Algorithm NewtonRaphson;
+
+@Gradient StrainStensor εᵗᵒ;
+εᵗᵒ.setGlossaryName("Strain");
+
+@ThermodynamicForce StressStensor σ;
+σ.setGlossaryName("Stress");
+
+@Gradient real pᴸᴿ;
+pᴸᴿ.setEntryName("LiquidPressure");
+
+@ThermodynamicForce real Sᴸ;
+Sᴸ.setEntryName("Saturation");
+
+@StateVariable StrainStensor εᵉˡ;
+εᵉˡ.setGlossaryName("ElasticStrain");
+
+@StateVariable real Λₚ;
+Λₚ.setGlossaryName("EquivalentPlasticStrain");
+
+@IntegrationVariable strain rpc;
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable stress pc;
+pc.setEntryName("PreConsolidationPressure");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real εᵛₚₗ;
+εᵛₚₗ.setEntryName("PlasticVolumetricStrain");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real vʳ;
+vʳ.setEntryName("VolumeRatio");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real n_l;
+n_l.setEntryName("n_l");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real rho_lR;
+rho_lR.setEntryName("rho_lR");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real epsilon_sw;
+epsilon_sw.setEntryName("epsilon_sw");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real phi_m;
+phi_m.setEntryName("phi_m");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real phi_M;
+phi_M.setEntryName("phi_M");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real phi_value;
+phi_value.setEntryName("phi");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real n_S_value;
+n_S_value.setEntryName("n_S");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real n_L_value;
+n_L_value.setEntryName("n_L");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real rho_LR_value;
+rho_LR_value.setEntryName("rho_LR");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real omega_l_value;
+omega_l_value.setEntryName("omega_l");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real mu_lR_value;
+mu_lR_value.setEntryName("mu_lR");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real rho_l_hat_value;
+rho_l_hat_value.setEntryName("rho_l_hat");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable real delta_epsilon_sw_value;
+delta_epsilon_sw_value.setEntryName("delta_epsilon_sw");
+
+@AuxiliaryStateVariable Stensor sigma_S_value;
+sigma_S_value.setEntryName("sigma_S");
+
+@Parameter stress pamb = 1e+3;
+@PhysicalBounds pamb in [0:*[;
+pamb.setEntryName("AmbientPressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty stress young;
+@PhysicalBounds young in [0:*[;
+young.setGlossaryName("YoungModulus");
+
+@MaterialProperty real ν;
+@PhysicalBounds ν in [-1:0.5];
+ν.setGlossaryName("PoissonRatio");
+
+@MaterialProperty real M;
+@PhysicalBounds M in [0:*[;
+M.setEntryName("CriticalStateLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real ka;
+@PhysicalBounds ka in [0:*[;
+ka.setEntryName("SwellingLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real la;
+@PhysicalBounds la in [0:*[;
+la.setEntryName("VirginConsolidationLineSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty stress pc_char;
+@PhysicalBounds pc_char in [0:*[;
+pc_char.setEntryName("CharacteristicPreConsolidationPressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴸʳ;
+Sᴸʳ.setEntryName("ResidualLiquidSaturation");
+
+@MaterialProperty real Sᴳʳ;
+Sᴳʳ.setEntryName("ResidualGasSaturation");
+
+@MaterialProperty real pᵇ;
+pᵇ.setEntryName("BubblePressure");
+
+@MaterialProperty real mⱽᴳ;
+mⱽᴳ.setEntryName("VanGenuchtenExponent_m");
+
+@MaterialProperty real macro_saturation_law_mode;
+@PhysicalBounds macro_saturation_law_mode in [0:*[;
+macro_saturation_law_mode.setEntryName("MacroSaturationLawMode");
+
+@MaterialProperty real microstate_local_solve_mode;
+@PhysicalBounds microstate_local_solve_mode in [0:*[;
+microstate_local_solve_mode.setEntryName("MicroStateLocalSolveMode");
+
+@MaterialProperty real micro_potential_convention;
+@PhysicalBounds micro_potential_convention in [0:*[;
+micro_potential_convention.setEntryName("MicroPotentialConvention");
+
+@MaterialProperty real swelling_slope;
+swelling_slope.setEntryName("SwellingSlope");
+
+@MaterialProperty real mass_exchange_coefficient;
+mass_exchange_coefficient.setEntryName("MassExchangeCoefficient");
+
+@MaterialProperty real macro_viscosity;
+macro_viscosity.setEntryName("MacroViscosity");
+
+@MaterialProperty real rho_LR_ref;
+rho_LR_ref.setEntryName("ReferenceLiquidDensityMacro");
+
+@MaterialProperty real rho_l0;
+rho_l0.setEntryName("ReferenceLiquidDensityMicro");
+
+@MaterialProperty real rho_SR;
+rho_SR.setEntryName("ReferenceDensitySolid");
+
+@MaterialProperty real density_a;
+density_a.setEntryName("MicroLiquidDensityA");
+
+@MaterialProperty real density_b;
+density_b.setEntryName("MicroLiquidDensityB");
+
+@MaterialProperty real hamaker_constant;
+hamaker_constant.setEntryName("HamakerConstant");
+
+@MaterialProperty real specific_surface;
+specific_surface.setEntryName("SpecificSurface");
+
+@MaterialProperty real area_factor_tuller;
+area_factor_tuller.setEntryName("AreaFactorTuller");
+
+@MaterialProperty real pore_area_shape_factor_tuller;
+pore_area_shape_factor_tuller.setEntryName("PoreAreaShapeFactorTuller");
+
+@MaterialProperty real characteristic_pore_size;
+characteristic_pore_size.setEntryName("CharacteristicPoreSize");
+
+@MaterialProperty real surface_tension;
+surface_tension.setEntryName("SurfaceTension");
+
+@MaterialProperty real phi0;
+phi0.setEntryName("InitialPorosity");
+
+@LocalVariable bool withinElasticRange;
+@LocalVariable real M²;
+@LocalVariable real pc_min;
+@LocalVariable real rpc_min;
+@LocalVariable real K;
+@LocalVariable StressStensor σ₀;
+@LocalVariable StiffnessTensor ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ;
+@LocalVariable real n_l_trial_value;
+@LocalVariable real rho_lR_trial_value;
+@LocalVariable real epsilon_sw_increment_trial;
+@LocalVariable real phi_m_trial_value;
+@LocalVariable real phi_M_trial_value;
+@LocalVariable real mu_lR_trial_value;
+@LocalVariable real rho_l_hat_trial_value;
+@LocalVariable real dn_l_dtrace_eps_trial;
+@LocalVariable real dn_l_dp_trial;
+@LocalVariable bool use_macro_saturation_law;
+@LocalVariable bool use_scalar_microstate_storage;
+@LocalVariable real micro_potential_sign;
+@LocalVariable real tuller_capillary_prefactor;
+@LocalVariable real macro_support_saturation_trial;
+
+@TangentOperatorBlocks{∂σ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ, ∂σ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ, ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δεᵗᵒ, ∂Sᴸ∕∂Δpᴸᴿ};
+
+@InitializeLocalVariables
+{
+    const auto Sₑ = [&](const auto pᶜᵃᵖ) {
+        return std::pow(
+            std::pow(std::max(pᶜᵃᵖ, 0.0) / pᵇ, 1.0 / (1.0 - mⱽᴳ)) + 1.0, -mⱽᴳ);
+    };
+
+    constexpr const auto pressure_tolerance = 1e-12;
+
+    use_macro_saturation_law = macro_saturation_law_mode > 0.5;
+    use_scalar_microstate_storage = microstate_local_solve_mode > 0.5;
+    tfel::raise_if(area_factor_tuller <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: AreaFactorTuller must be positive.");
+    tfel::raise_if(pore_area_shape_factor_tuller <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: PoreAreaShapeFactorTuller must be positive.");
+    tfel::raise_if(characteristic_pore_size <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: CharacteristicPoreSize must be positive.");
+    tfel::raise_if(surface_tension <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: SurfaceTension must be positive.");
+    tuller_capillary_prefactor =
+        4.0 * pore_area_shape_factor_tuller * surface_tension * surface_tension /
+        (area_factor_tuller * characteristic_pore_size * characteristic_pore_size);
+
+    const auto macro_saturation_law = [&](const auto p_arg) {
+        if (p_arg < -pressure_tolerance)
+        {
+            const auto capillary_term = tuller_capillary_prefactor / (p_arg * p_arg);
+            return 1.0 - std::exp(-capillary_term);
+        }
+        return 1.0;
+    };
+
+    const auto S = use_macro_saturation_law
+                       ? macro_saturation_law(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ)
+                       : Sₑ(-(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ)) * (1.0 - Sᴳʳ - Sᴸʳ) + Sᴸʳ;
+    Sᴸ = use_macro_saturation_law ? S : std::clamp(S, Sᴸʳ, 1.0 - Sᴳʳ);
+    macro_support_saturation_trial = macro_saturation_law(pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ);
+
+    tfel::raise_if(la < ka, "Invalid parameters: la<ka");
+    M² = M * M;
+
+    εᵉˡ = (1.0 + ν) / young * σ - ν / young * trace(σ) * I₂;
+    σ₀ = σ;
+
+    rpc = pc / young;
+    pc_min = 1e-15 * pc_char;
+    rpc_min = pc_min / young;
+
+    K = young / (3.0 * (1.0 - 2.0 * ν));
+    ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ = young / (1.0 + ν) * Stensor4::K() + K * Stensor4::IxI();
+
+    const auto σᵉˡ = σ₀ + ∂σ∕∂εᵉˡ * Δεᵗᵒ;
+    const auto sᵉˡ = deviator(σᵉˡ);
+    const auto qᵉˡ = sqrt(1.5 * sᵉˡ | sᵉˡ);
+    const auto pᵉˡ = -trace(σᵉˡ) / 3.0 + pamb;
+    const auto fᵉˡ = qᵉˡ * qᵉˡ + M² * pᵉˡ * (pᵉˡ - pc);
+    withinElasticRange = fᵉˡ < 0;
+
+    constexpr const auto pi = 3.14159265358979323846;
+    constexpr const auto minimum_n_l = 1e-14;
+    constexpr const auto minimum_density_gap = 1e-12;
+    constexpr const auto newton_tolerance = 1e-11;
+    constexpr const auto max_iterations = 64u;
+    const auto hamaker_magnitude = std::abs(hamaker_constant);
+    micro_potential_sign =
+        (micro_potential_convention > 0.5 ? -1.0 : 1.0) *
+        (hamaker_constant >= 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0);
+
+    tfel::raise_if(phi0 <= 0.0 || phi0 >= 1.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: InitialPorosity must lie in (0,1).");
+    tfel::raise_if(rho_LR_ref <= 0.0 || rho_l0 <= 0.0 || rho_SR <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid density parameter: all reference densities must be positive.");
+    tfel::raise_if(macro_viscosity <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: MacroViscosity must be positive.");
+    tfel::raise_if(hamaker_magnitude <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: HamakerConstant must be non-zero.");
+    tfel::raise_if(specific_surface <= 0.0,
+                   "Invalid parameter: SpecificSurface must be positive.");
+
+    const auto p = pᴸᴿ + Δpᴸᴿ;
+    const auto delta_epsilon_v = trace(Δεᵗᵒ);
+    const auto zero_dt = std::abs(dt) < 1e-15;
+    constexpr const auto porosity_upper = 1.0 - 1e-12;
+    const auto phi_total_from_state =
+        std::max(phi_m, 0.0) + std::max(phi_M, 0.0);
+    const auto phi_total_prev =
+        (std::isfinite(phi_total_from_state) &&
+         phi_total_from_state > minimum_n_l)
+            ? std::clamp(phi_total_from_state, minimum_n_l, porosity_upper)
+            : std::clamp(phi0, minimum_n_l, porosity_upper);
+    const auto porosity_denominator = 1.0 + delta_epsilon_v;
+    const auto phi_total_trial =
+        (std::isfinite(porosity_denominator) &&
+         std::abs(porosity_denominator) > 1e-12)
+            ? std::clamp((phi_total_prev + delta_epsilon_v) /
+                             porosity_denominator,
+                         minimum_n_l, porosity_upper)
+            : phi_total_prev;
+    const auto n_s = std::max(minimum_n_l, 1.0 - phi_total_trial);
+    const auto n_l_upper_bound = std::max(phi_total_trial, minimum_n_l);
+    const auto n_l_prev = std::clamp(n_l, minimum_n_l, n_l_upper_bound);
+    const auto rho_lR_prev =
+        std::max(rho_lR, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+    const auto phi_m_prev = n_l_prev;
+    const auto previous_mass = n_l_prev * rho_lR_prev;
+
+    const auto macro_density_from_state = [&](const auto rho_macro_arg) {
+        return std::max(rho_macro_arg, rho_LR_ref + minimum_density_gap);
+    };
+
+    const auto alpha_M_effective_from_density = [&](const auto rho_macro_arg) {
+        const auto rho_macro_safe = macro_density_from_state(rho_macro_arg);
+        return mass_exchange_coefficient * rho_macro_safe / macro_viscosity;
+    };
+
+    const auto mu_macro_from_pressure = [&](const auto p_arg,
+                                            const auto rho_macro_arg) {
+        const auto rho_macro_safe = macro_density_from_state(rho_macro_arg);
+        return p_arg > -pressure_tolerance ? 0.0 : p_arg / rho_macro_safe;
+    };
+
+    const auto omega_from_state = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                                      const auto rho_lR_arg) {
+        return n_l_arg * rho_lR_arg / (n_s * rho_SR);
+    };
+
+    const auto rho_micro_eos = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                                   const auto rho_lR_arg) {
+        const auto omega =
+            std::max(omega_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg), minimum_n_l);
+        return rho_l0 * std::exp(-density_a * std::pow(omega, density_b)) +
+               rho_LR_ref;
+    };
+
+    const auto mu_micro_from_state = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                                         const auto rho_lR_arg) {
+        const auto omega =
+            std::max(omega_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_lR_arg), minimum_n_l);
+        return (micro_potential_sign * hamaker_magnitude * rho_lR_arg *
+                rho_lR_arg * rho_lR_arg /
+                (6.0 * pi)) *
+               std::pow(specific_surface / omega, 3.0);
+    };
+
+    const auto solve_microstate = [&](const auto p_arg,
+                                      const auto delta_epsilon_v_arg,
+                                      const auto n_l_prev_arg,
+                                      const auto rho_lR_prev_arg,
+                                      double& n_l_out,
+                                      double& rho_lR_out,
+                                      double& mu_lR_out,
+                                      double& rho_l_hat_out) {
+        const auto rho_macro_step =
+            macro_density_from_state(rho_lR_prev_arg);
+
+        if (use_scalar_microstate_storage)
+        {
+            auto n_l_trial =
+                std::clamp(n_l_prev_arg, minimum_n_l, n_l_upper_bound);
+            const auto rho_scalar = rho_macro_step;
+
+            const auto evaluate_scalar = [&](const auto n_l_arg,
+                                             double& residual_arg,
+                                             double& mu_lR_arg,
+                                             double& rho_l_hat_arg) {
+                const auto mu_LR_arg =
+                    mu_macro_from_pressure(p_arg, rho_scalar);
+                const auto alpha_M_effective =
+                    alpha_M_effective_from_density(rho_scalar);
+                mu_lR_arg = mu_micro_from_state(n_l_arg, rho_scalar);
+                rho_l_hat_arg = alpha_M_effective * (mu_LR_arg - mu_lR_arg);
+                residual_arg = n_l_arg - n_l_prev_arg -
+                               dt * rho_l_hat_arg / rho_scalar -
+                               n_l_arg * delta_epsilon_v_arg;
+            };
+
+            const auto assign_scalar_state = [&](const auto n_l_candidate_arg) {
+                n_l_out = std::clamp(n_l_candidate_arg, minimum_n_l,
+                                     n_l_upper_bound);
+                double residual_dummy = 0.0;
+                evaluate_scalar(n_l_out, residual_dummy, mu_lR_out,
+                                rho_l_hat_out);
+                rho_lR_out = rho_scalar;
+            };
+
+            const auto solve_scalar_bracketed =
+                [&](double& n_l_bracketed_out,
+                    double& mu_lR_bracketed_out,
+                    double& rho_l_hat_bracketed_out) {
+                    constexpr const auto bracket_scan_points = 256u;
+                    auto n_l_lo = minimum_n_l;
+                    auto n_l_hi = n_l_upper_bound;
+
+                    double residual_lo = 0.0;
+                    double residual_hi = 0.0;
+                    double mu_lo = 0.0;
+                    double mu_hi = 0.0;
+                    double rho_hat_lo = 0.0;
+                    double rho_hat_hi = 0.0;
+
+                    evaluate_scalar(n_l_lo, residual_lo, mu_lo, rho_hat_lo);
+                    evaluate_scalar(n_l_hi, residual_hi, mu_hi, rho_hat_hi);
+
+                    if (residual_lo * residual_hi > 0.0)
+                    {
+                        const auto log_n_l_min = std::log10(minimum_n_l);
+                        const auto log_n_l_max = std::log10(n_l_hi);
+                        auto previous_n_l = n_l_lo;
+                        auto previous_residual = residual_lo;
+                        auto previous_mu = mu_lo;
+                        auto previous_rho_hat = rho_hat_lo;
+                        auto found_bracket = false;
+
+                        for (unsigned int i = 1; i <= bracket_scan_points; ++i)
+                        {
+                            const auto log_n_l =
+                                log_n_l_min +
+                                (log_n_l_max - log_n_l_min) *
+                                    (static_cast<double>(i) /
+                                     bracket_scan_points);
+                            const auto n_l_candidate = std::clamp(
+                                std::pow(10.0, log_n_l), minimum_n_l,
+                                n_l_upper_bound);
+
+                            double residual_candidate = 0.0;
+                            double mu_candidate = 0.0;
+                            double rho_hat_candidate = 0.0;
+                            evaluate_scalar(n_l_candidate, residual_candidate,
+                                            mu_candidate,
+                                            rho_hat_candidate);
+
+                            if (previous_residual * residual_candidate <= 0.0)
+                            {
+                                n_l_lo = previous_n_l;
+                                residual_lo = previous_residual;
+                                mu_lo = previous_mu;
+                                rho_hat_lo = previous_rho_hat;
+
+                                n_l_hi = n_l_candidate;
+                                residual_hi = residual_candidate;
+                                mu_hi = mu_candidate;
+                                rho_hat_hi = rho_hat_candidate;
+                                found_bracket = true;
+                                break;
+                            }
+
+                            previous_n_l = n_l_candidate;
+                            previous_residual = residual_candidate;
+                            previous_mu = mu_candidate;
+                            previous_rho_hat = rho_hat_candidate;
+                        }
+
+                        if (!found_bracket)
+                        {
+                            return false;
+                        }
+                    }
+
+                    for (unsigned int iteration = 0;
+                         iteration < 4 * max_iterations; ++iteration)
+                    {
+                        const auto n_l_mid = 0.5 * (n_l_lo + n_l_hi);
+                        double residual_mid = 0.0;
+                        double mu_mid = 0.0;
+                        double rho_hat_mid = 0.0;
+                        evaluate_scalar(n_l_mid, residual_mid, mu_mid,
+                                        rho_hat_mid);
+
+                        if (std::abs(residual_mid) < newton_tolerance ||
+                            std::abs(n_l_hi - n_l_lo) <
+                                newton_tolerance *
+                                    std::max(1.0, std::abs(n_l_mid)))
+                        {
+                            n_l_bracketed_out = n_l_mid;
+                            mu_lR_bracketed_out = mu_mid;
+                            rho_l_hat_bracketed_out = rho_hat_mid;
+                            return true;
+                        }
+
+                        if (residual_lo * residual_mid <= 0.0)
+                        {
+                            n_l_hi = n_l_mid;
+                            residual_hi = residual_mid;
+                        }
+                        else
+                        {
+                            n_l_lo = n_l_mid;
+                            residual_lo = residual_mid;
+                        }
+                    }
+
+                    const auto n_l_mid = 0.5 * (n_l_lo + n_l_hi);
+                    double residual_mid = 0.0;
+                    double mu_mid = 0.0;
+                    double rho_hat_mid = 0.0;
+                    evaluate_scalar(n_l_mid, residual_mid, mu_mid,
+                                    rho_hat_mid);
+                    n_l_bracketed_out = n_l_mid;
+                    mu_lR_bracketed_out = mu_mid;
+                    rho_l_hat_bracketed_out = rho_hat_mid;
+                    return true;
+                };
+
+            for (unsigned int iteration = 0; iteration < max_iterations;
+                 ++iteration)
+            {
+                double residual = 0.0;
+                double mu_trial = 0.0;
+                double rho_hat_trial = 0.0;
+                evaluate_scalar(n_l_trial, residual, mu_trial, rho_hat_trial);
+
+                if (std::abs(residual) < newton_tolerance)
+                {
+                    assign_scalar_state(n_l_trial);
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                const auto dn_scale =
+                    std::max(1e-8, std::abs(n_l_trial) * 1e-6);
+                double residual_n = 0.0;
+                double mu_n = 0.0;
+                double rho_hat_n = 0.0;
+                evaluate_scalar(
+                    std::clamp(n_l_trial + dn_scale, minimum_n_l,
+                               n_l_upper_bound),
+                    residual_n, mu_n, rho_hat_n);
+
+                const auto scalar_jacobian =
+                    (residual_n - residual) / dn_scale;
+                if (!(std::isfinite(scalar_jacobian) &&

+                }

+                const auto delta_n = -residual / scalar_jacobian;

+                auto accepted = false;
+
+                for (unsigned int line_search = 0; line_search < 8;
+                     ++line_search)
+                {
+                    const auto n_candidate =
+                        std::clamp(n_l_trial + step_scale * delta_n,
+                                   minimum_n_l, n_l_upper_bound);
+                    double residual_candidate = 0.0;
+                    double mu_candidate = 0.0;
+                    double rho_hat_candidate = 0.0;
+                    evaluate_scalar(n_candidate, residual_candidate,
+                                    mu_candidate, rho_hat_candidate);
+
+                    if (std::abs(residual_candidate) <
+                        std::abs(residual) * (1.0 - 1e-4 * step_scale))

+                        break;
+                    }

+                    step_scale *= 0.5;
+                }
+
+                if (!accepted)
+                {
+                    if (solve_scalar_bracketed(n_l_out, mu_lR_out,
+                                               rho_l_hat_out))
